youtube.title: Velcro Ek Kutte Ki Wajah Se Bana Tha? 🐕 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Velcro ki kahani shuru hui ek kutte ki walk se. 1941 mein Swiss engineer George de Mestral hike se ghar lauty, aur unka kutta aur unki trousers burrs se bhari thi, wahi nukile beej jo har cheez se chipak jaate hain. Zyada tar log unhe nikaal kar fenk dete, par unhone ek burr ko microscope ke neeche rakha.

Unhe saikdon chhote hooks dikhe, jo fur aur kapde ke har chhote loop ko pakad rahe the. Unhone nature ko copy kiya: hooks ki ek strip aur loops ki ek strip. Sahi banane mein saalon lage. Naam do French shabdon se aaya, velours aur crochet. Aaj Velcro shoes, jackets aur astronauts ke suits tak mein hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
